evaluation_protocol.name: within_person_chronological
evaluation_protocol.description: Per participant, meal episodes are ordered by timestamp; the earliest 75% train and the latest 25% are held out. Splits are by whole meal episode. Five-minute CGM rows are never randomly split. Imputers, scalers and participant calibration are fitted on the training fold only.

limitations: No evaluation has been run against this artifact, so no validated metrics exist.
Run `python -m ml.evaluate --protocol within_person_chronological` to populate this report.
